glosses: safe, coffer (box in which valuables can be locked for safekeeping)

examples.text: Eu coloquei o dinheiro no cofre.
examples.en: I put the money into the safe.

examples.text: Eu tenho algumas coisas no cofre do hotel.
examples.en: I have some things in the hotel safe.

examples.text: Eu tenho uma corda no meu cofre.
examples.en: I've got a rope in my trunk.
